title: Possum's Item Frames
description: Frame invisibility, rotation tweaks, and chest compatibility!
body:
# Possum's Item Frames
## Features
- Toggle item frame visibility by right-clicking with shears. 
- Items in invisible item frames cannot be rotated unless the user is crouching.
- You can 'click through' item frames to easily access chests behind them (great for storage rooms).
- Operator-only commands.

## Commands

### /pif enable
Enable the plugin.

### /pif disable 
Disable the plugin. 

### /pif status
Get the global status of the plugin (enabled/disabled).

### /pif reload
Reload the config.yml file.
